title: QualiTranslate: forward translation, blind back-translation, reconciliation and recorded human review for qualitative interview transcripts
description: QualiTranslate is a Python and R package for translating qualitative interview transcripts with large language models. It separates forward translation, blind back-translation and reconciliation, requires a recorded human decision for every section, and exports the prompts, replies, audit trail and a draft methods paragraph.
